data.title: Area Manager - Portugal (Lisbon, Faro or Porto based)
data.description:
About Us

 

At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 

Role Description

 

As the Area Manager for Portugal, based within daily commuting distance of Lisbon (preferred, Faro, or Porto, you will report to the Regional Manager for the Iberia Region and lead the Partner Services organisation in the market, helping a diverse portfolio of partners, from independent boutique hotels in Lisbon to large resort chains in the Algarve to grow their businesses through insight-led account management. This pivotal role combines people leadership, commercial judgement, market understanding, and cross-functional influence to drive performance and innovation. You will translate regional strategy into actionable plans, foster a high-performing environment, and act as a key advocate for Booking.com within the Portuguese market.

 

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead and Develop: Coach and guide the Portugal Partner Services team of Market Team Managers and indirectly manage a team of Account Managers and more to build a high-performing, inclusive environment with clear priorities.

  • Strategic Execution: Translate regional strategy into a focused, actionable Portugal market plan and monitor progress against objectives.

  • Portfolio Management: Capitalize on Portugal's booming year-round tourism by driving portfolio health, partner coverage, and commercial outcomes through data-led prioritisation and targeted interventions. You are responsible for  driving revenue growth, increasing property listings and improving partner retention etc. 

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Build trusted relationships with local partners and collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve problems.

  • Change Leadership: Lead the team through digital transformation and the rollout of new commercial strategies

Qualifications & Skills

  • Leadership Experience: Proven track record in leading commercial, account-management, or partner-services teams, focusing on coaching and performance improvement.

  • Commercial Judgement: Strong ability to balance partner value, business impact, and market opportunities, with a highly data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Strategic Execution: Capability to turn strategy into actionable plans, track progress, and adapt to shifting priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence peers and senior leaders across global product, public affairs, finance , and customer service teams

  • Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Portuguese accommodation market and native/bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional fluency in English.

Please submit your resume and application in English.

 

Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

 

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

 

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 EUR per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

Inclusion at Booking.com:

 

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

 

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

 

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Application Process:

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire

  • This role does not come with relocation assistance.

 

Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.


Please submit your resume and application in English.


Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

Role Description

Customer Service plays a critical role in protecting the traveler experience when things go wrong—and in preventing problems before they occur. As the Group Product Manager for Traveler Experience, you will lead the shift from fragmented, reactive support toward a seamless, preventive, personalized, and AI-enabled resolution experience across the Connected Trip. You will partner closely with Service Process Design (SPD) to shape a cohesive end-to-end strategy, bringing product, AI, workflow automation, and human care together at scale. By connecting traveler needs with unified agent capabilities and intelligent operations, you will make Customer Service a true competitive advantage for Booking.com while leading and developing a talented team of Product Managers.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

  • Set Portfolio Strategy & Outcomes: Co-create the Traveler Experience strategy with Service Process Design, translating business goals into executable roadmaps, objectives, and clear trade-offs across traveler value, loyalty, cost to serve, and operational feasibility.

  • Transform End-to-End Traveler Journeys: Partner across teams to tackle root causes of friction in core resolution paths—such as cancellations, relocations, complaints, and Genius-related experiences—ensuring seamless cross-channel support.

  • Build AI-Enabled & Preventive Service: Lead the evolution of self-service, workflow automation (Pega), AI agents, back-office tooling, and intelligent routing, ensuring safe, privacy-aware, and explainable AI handovers to human agents.

  • Scale Differentiated Services: Develop personalized capabilities and routing for high-value travelers, Genius segments, and urgent moments to maximize satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

  • Lead Portfolio Delivery & Health: Oversee delivery flow, vendor integration, legacy modernisation, and platform stability, balancing short-term execution with long-term technical and operational health.

  • Lead and Develop Product Talent: Lead, coach, and mentor Product Managers and Senior Product Managers within the value stream, building a high-performing product organization and contributing to the wider Booking.com product craft.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Product Leadership Experience: Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience, with a strong track record in product management, portfolio ownership, and developing Product Managers/Senior Product Managers.

  • Domain Expertise: Experience in high-volume, operationally complex, or regulated environments such as Customer Service, travel, marketplaces, e-commerce, or contact centers.

  • AI & Automation Knowledge: Proven experience with service transformation, self-service platforms, CRM/case management (e.g., Pega), agentic workflows, or AI-enabled products.

  • Journey Transformation & Personalization: Demonstrated success improving customer journeys, service recovery, omnichannel workflows, or differentiated/loyalty service experiences at scale.

  • Data & Prioritization Mastery: Excellent analytical skills with experience defining metrics, running experiments, and managing complex trade-offs between customer, business, and technical needs.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills, capable of driving alignment across multidisciplinary teams in a matrix environment.

data.title: Technical Program Manager - IT Services
data.description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. About the team: Booking.com IT Services size and technical complexity require specialists who can drive cross-organisational initiatives with significant technology dependencies. As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead delivery from problem framing through implementation and measurable outcome. You will work directly with engineering, product and operational stakeholders to establish scope, ownership, realistic plans, delivery rhythms and decision-making. You will bring an independent view of progress, surface risk early and help teams make practical trade-offs without adding unnecessary process.

This is an individual-contributor role. It does not include people management. The role may support global services and stakeholders, but its organisational delivery scope is calibrated to TPM rather than Senior TPM.

 

About the role: You will independently lead the delivery of technically complex, cross-team initiatives that solve business and internal-customer problems. Working across several engineering and product teams, typically within one track or product group, you will translate an end-to-end technical solution into a realistic program structure, align priorities and ownership, and deliver incremental, measurable value for Booking.com employees and internal customers.

 

Who you work with

 

Internal stakeholders

You will work continuously with engineering, product, operations, security, privacy and business teams across Booking.com and relevant Booking Holdings functions. The role requires cooperation, persuasion and clear information-sharing to align priorities and deliver outcomes.

 

External stakeholders

You may work frequently with technology and service vendors, using clear requirements, delivery plans, risk ownership and performance expectations to support program outcomes.

 

Role accountability

This is an individual-contributor role with no direct people-management or P&L responsibility. Programs may support globally distributed teams and services, while the organisational delivery scope remains aligned with a TPM role: normally several teams within a track or product group. Decisions and outcomes typically influence the short-to-mid-term delivery horizon.

 

 


Perhaps in the "what you bring" mentioning expertise of different delivery methodologies (such as Agile and Lean)?

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead small-to-medium, technically complex programs and cross-team initiatives with meaningful business or internal-customer impact, normally spanning several teams within a track or product group.

  • Translate business and internal-customer problems, technical designs and non-functional requirements into a clear delivery structure, milestones and iterative value slices.

  • Create and maintain realistic, outcome-based plans using relevant delivery and operational metrics.

  • Clarify decision rights, ownership and accountability across workstreams; make dependencies and the critical path visible.

  • Identify and manage technical and delivery risks, issues and changes; define mitigation plans (after discussing options with the right owners)

  • Build alignment across engineering, product, security, privacy, operations and business stakeholders, influencing without formal authority.

  • Communicate concise program updates and decisions at the right level of detail, including to Director-level stakeholders.

  • Establish fit-for-purpose governance and delivery practices that work across teams with different ways of working.

  • Use retrospectives, delivery data and feedback to improve predictability, quality and team collaboration.

  • Contribute practical learning and reusable delivery practices to the TPM craft community.

  • Define and maintain program documentation, ensure functional and non-functional requirements are captured, and partner with engineering teams so supporting technical documentation is produced and maintained.

  • Drive the planning, documentation and communication of strategic programs with leaders across Booking.com and, where relevant, Booking Holdings.

What success looks like

  • Teams understand the outcome, their ownership and how their work connects to the end-to-end solution.

  • Plans are credible, continuously updated and focused on incremental value rather than activity alone.

  • Risks, dependencies and priority conflicts are visible early and have clear owners and decisions.

  • Stakeholders receive concise, evidence-based information and can make timely trade-offs.

  • Programs deliver measurable business, employee, reliability, security, cost or operational outcomes.

  • Delivery practices become simpler and more effective without creating unnecessary governance.

Role Qualifications and Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in product, project, program or technical program management, working directly with engineering or software-development teams to build, implement or launch technical solutions.

  • Evidence of personally leading an end-to-end technical program lifecycle: discovery, scope, planning, execution, release or implementation, outcome measurement and learning.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to understand and explain system components, interfaces, data flows, functional and non-functional requirements, testing or release approaches, failure modes and trade-offs.

  • Strong delivery-management capability, including iterative planning, sequencing, dependency management, critical-path awareness, risk and issue management, and useful progress metrics.

  • Ability to align stakeholders and influence decisions without authority, including when teams have competing priorities.

  • Clear written, verbal and visual communication; able to adapt detail and framing for engineers, managers and Directors.

  • A data-informed, customer-oriented and pragmatic approach to navigating ambiguity, solving problems and making decisions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong business awareness and technical vision.

  • Curiosity and ability to understand architectural and technical aspects of programs and their long-term consequences.

  • Expertise of different delivery methodologies (such as Agile and Lean)

Preferred context

  • Cloud infrastructure, SaaS business applications or DevOps practices.

  • Identity and access management, including platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity; networking, remote access or internal-platform services.

  • Programs serving internal customers, including work with vendors or distributed teams.

  • Programming or engineering background; business-continuity, regulatory or compliance exposure.

  • Jira, Jira Align or comparable planning and delivery tooling.

AI affinity and mindset

  • Show curiosity and practical understanding of AI tools and how they can improve work, not just generic enthusiasm.

  • Demonstrate safe AI habits: awareness of hallucinations, privacy, data handling, corporate guardrails, and the need to validate outputs.

  • Identify relevant AI use cases for AV/VC operations, such as incident summarisation, log analysis, monitoring insights, knowledge discovery, vendor documentation analysis, meeting room issue triage, runbook generation, and support workflow automation.

  • Be able to set context-rich prompts, refine outputs, and validate AI-generated work before using it in operational or stakeholder-facing decisions.

  • Actively encourage responsible AI adoption in the team, while avoiding overclaiming what AI can do or replacing human judgment with unchecked AI output.

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit 

  • Living and working in Amsterdam, one of the most cosmopolitan cities in Europe

  • Contributing to a high scale, complex, world renowned product and seeing real-time impact of your work on millions of travelers worldwide

About the team: Booking.com’s Application Security team is responsible for protecting the world’s largest travel platform against attacks targeting our application stack. The team develops and maintains the signals, tools, and infrastructure used to secure Booking.com products and defines secure coding practices for all developers. We work closely with product and engineering teams to ensure customer data remains safe through secure-by-design software architecture.

Role Description: As an Application Security Engineer, you will play a key role in safeguarding the security and privacy of Booking.com customers. You will build and operate advanced security tooling, automate remediation, analyze security indicators, and partner with product teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.

Your expertise will directly contribute to the detection, prevention, and response to application security threats across Booking.com’s global platform.

Key responsibilities

  • Review applications, APIs, and designs to identify basic security risks.

  • Support secure code reviews and vulnerability assessments.

  • Help teams understand and remediate common web vulnerabilities.

  • Contribute to threat modelling and security requirements for new features.

  • Help integrate and maintain security checks in CI/CD pipelines, such as SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets scanning.

  • Support security reviews of AI- and LLM-enabled applications, where applicable.

  • Help identify basic AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, model or data poisoning, and unbounded consumption.

  • Investigate security findings, assess their priority, and track remediation.

  • Support the configuration and use of application security tools.

  • Write simple scripts or automation to improve security processes.

  • Document findings, security requirements, procedures, and recommendations.

  • Work collaboratively with software engineers, platform teams, and security colleagues.

  • Keep up to date with common application security threats and defensive practices.

What we are looking for

  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of application and web security.

  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Familiarity with common risks such as injection, broken access control, authentication failures, security misconfiguration, cross-site scripting, and insecure dependencies.

  • Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and basic secure coding principles.

  • Familiarity with HTTP, APIs, authentication, authorization, and TLS.

  • Ability to read and understand code in at least one programming language.

  • Basic scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or a similar language.

  • Some experience with application security tools, such as SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, vulnerability scanners, or secrets-scanning tools.

  • Basic understanding of how LLM applications work, including prompts, model inputs and outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool or API integrations.

  • Basic understanding of how to secure LLM applications through input and output validation, data minimisation, access control, least privilege, rate limiting, logging, and human approval for high-impact actions.

  • Ability to communicate security findings clearly and constructively.

  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

  • Ability to work effectively with developers and other technical teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud platforms, containers, or infrastructure as code.

  • Familiarity with API security or microservices.

  • Experience or interest in securing AI or LLM-enabled applications.

  • Experience with threat modelling or security testing.

  • Familiarity with vulnerability management or incident response.

  • Knowledge of privacy or security requirements relevant to software development.

  • Security certifications or relevant practical projects.

What success looks like

  • You identify and explain common application security risks.

  • Development teams receive practical remediation guidance.

  • Security checks are applied consistently during software development.

  • Findings are documented, prioritised, and followed through to resolution.

  • You build deeper application security expertise through hands-on work and continuous learning.
